title: The Work order lines card has no View column (View comes from Work orders)
custom_preconds: 1. Open Create Role (or edit a custom role).
custom_steps: 1. Compare the columns of the Work orders card and the Work order lines card.
custom_expected:
Work orders shows View, Create & Edit and Delete.

Work order lines shows only Create & Edit and Delete — there is no View column, because Work order lines View comes from Work orders View.
evidence: Work order lines card structure (no View column) build-verified.
